data.name: Anders III: Coast Of Pain
data.detailed_description:
Game Description
Uncover dark secrets in Anders: The Cursed Coast, a third-person psychological thriller where you step into the shoes of Anders, a reclusive young man haunted by a traumatic past. Roam a semi-open coastal landscape—combining abandoned suburbs, windswept roads, eerie forest paths, and forgotten crime scenes.

Use your drone to scan and investigate the environment. Search for clues, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together a broken past as you experience a story-driven exploration of grief, trauma, and redemption. You’ll drive through haunting backroads, confront disturbing visions, and decide how Anders faces his inner demons.

Features:

  • Story-Driven Exploration: Immerse yourself in a deeply personal narrative inspired by real emotional struggles.

  • Semi-Open World: Explore coastal roads, foggy forests, suburban ruins, and hidden bunkers at your own pace.

  • Drones & Scanning Tools: Deploy a drone to access hard-to-reach areas, uncover secrets, and investigate scenes.

  • Driving Gameplay: Drive through winding roads between key locations, enhancing immersion and isolation.

  • Visual Novel Elements: Dialogue choices and ambient storytelling reveal Anders’ fractured memories and inner conflict.

  • Atmospheric Design: Minimal UI, cinematic camera angles, ambient music, and environmental storytelling build an emotional, suspenseful experience.
